items.title: David Montgomery: On track to play Thursday
items.text:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans confirmed that Montgomery (groin) is trending toward playing in Thursday's game against the Colts, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Cleared to resume practicing
items.text:

items.title: Luther Burden: Clears concussion protocol
items.text:

items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson: Heads to IR with ankle injury

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Practices again Tuesday
